--dns-cluster-ip <service-cidr-dns-ip>\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n**NJ20:** AL2023 uses `nodeadm` instead of `bootstrap.sh`:\\\\n```\\\\nMIME-Version: 1.0\\\\nContent-Type: multipart/mixed;
